name: ecommerce-returns-livewire
description: Livewire 4 storefront returns presenting the return requests owned by liberusoftware/ecommerce-returns: a shopper's own returns and nobody else's, a request whose returnable quantity is read on the server every time and never accepted from the browser, a reason chosen from a closed set of slugs, and a note that goes in and cannot come back out.
features: A shopper's own returns, scoped to the signed-in account before anything else
A return addressed by its RMA number, never by an incrementing id
Somebody else's RMA number answered exactly as one that was never minted
A signed-out visitor shown a sign-in prompt rather than a 404, so no answer is an oracle
Store-scoped reads, with a bound comparison rather than a null one
Returnable quantity read on the server every request, never accepted from the browser
An order line the shopper does not own refused with the same words as one that does not exist
Reasons validated by identity against the domain's closed set of slugs
A shopper's note accepted, refused rather than truncated, and unable to travel back out
The domain's quantity refusal surfaced in words rather than silently capped
Cancellation of a request offered only where the state machine will accept it
Approving, receiving, inspecting and resolving left to staff
A return closed to further goods says what to do instead of showing a dead end
Only the statuses the domain publishes are ever rendered
No amount a shopper can set: what was refunded is a sum over rows
Every public property locked, with no exceptions list
Money rendered from integer minor units by string arithmetic
A live region for every outcome, and an alert for every refusal
